agent_url.description: URL of the persona agent's gateway endpoint (POST /webhook/gateway).

gateway_token.description: Shared secret used for the gateway bearer header and replay-resistant HMAC envelope. It must match the agent's GATEWAY_TOKEN. A non-empty value is required for every off-host endpoint.

timeout_s.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for one agent round-trip. The agent simulates human typing delays before answering, so keep this generous.

excluded_platforms.description: Platform adapter names that must NOT be forwarded. Keep aiocqhttp here when NapCat already feeds the agent directly through /webhook/qq, otherwise QQ messages would be handled twice. To make AstrBot the single inbound path for QQ as well, remove it, stop NapCat posting to /webhook/qq, and set GATEWAY_NATIVE_PLATFORMS=aiocqhttp on the agent so QQ ids stay spelled the way every store on disk already spells them.

group_whitelist.description: Group IDs to forward. Default-deny: an empty list forwards no groups.

private_enabled.description: Enable forwarding for explicitly allowlisted private (direct) senders.

private_whitelist.description: Sender IDs allowed in private chat. Default-deny: an empty list allows no senders.

block_default.description: Stop the AstrBot pipeline after forwarding so the built-in LLM never double-replies in conversations owned by the agent.
